svg.title: Icon weight at row sizes: Phosphor Regular, Phosphor Bold, Lucide-style 2 px stroke
svg.desc: Own comparison board. Glyph artwork: Phosphor Icons (MIT) and Lucide (ISC), drawn at 3x so stroke weight is visible; invented labels.
svg.text: Icon weight at row sizes (shown at 3×; the box under each glyph is its real size)
Stroke in real pixels = stroke units / grid × size. Phosphor Regular 16/256, Bold 24/256, Light 12/256; Lucide-style 2/24. Colour = muted #AEACA4 on the dark sidebar #1F1E1D.
Regular at 12–14 px draws 0.75–0.88 px strokes: on a dark ground the glyph looks faint next to 13 px text. That is today's row glyph (12–13 px).
A Lucide-style 14 px glyph has a 1.17 px stroke: this is the weight the Superset sidebar uses. Phosphor Bold at 12–13 px lands on the same weight (1.13–1.22 px) with the
Rule: Regular for 16 px and up (nav, headers, buttons); Bold for 12–14 px (row leading glyphs, tab icons, status glyphs). One family, two weights, chosen by size, not by hand.
